JUST DON’T GO
Jan 2025 • Solo
I’ve been today evening to this place.
TERRIBLE - the food / the service / the décor.
The Nem (deep fried spring rolls) were oily and not tasteful. I tried just one and left the 3 others.
The Sauteed noodle with seafood consist in noodles from Mamanoodles (10 bath) and some vegetables with a minimum of seafood (mainly squid). Very easy and tasteless food. 
When I entered the restaurant the unfriendly staff told me that I could only get a seat at the entrance door as all was on reservation. Then they brought me to the second floor and assigned me the only available table to me.
Just to mention: there was nobody when I came in, nobody during my stay (except 3 desperate tourists) and nobody when I left.
The whole restaurant sent a feeling of outworn and don’t believe the photos in their internet gallery, they don’t reflect the reality. 
DON’T GO, there are myriads of better opportunities
